|errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hansoloinnocentscoundrel-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-01-Han_Solo_Innocent_Scoundrel.png]]). The later errata version is [[Han Solo, Innocent Scoundrel (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet (official text as of 11 May 2012)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 8.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 11 May 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 July 2012), page 5, slip 27 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095418/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf#page=5 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle, may fire a [Virtual Block 8] blaster twice. Once per turn, if opponent is about to draw weapon destiny targeting Han, they draw two and you choose one. Immune to attrition < 3 (< 4 if armed).” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-hansoloinnocentscoundrel-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-01-Han_Solo_Innocent_Scoundrel.png]]) print it. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 8) prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=8, page 8. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=8 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Han Solo, Innocent Scoundrel (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 12 December 2012 and in the capture of 11 January 2013) wrote the pilot icon out (“Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots.”), added “Han” (“During battle, Han may fire”) and “a” (“draw a weapon destiny”), and printed “(<4 if armed)”<ref name="cl-1281_27-2012-12-12">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive); the same text in the capture of 11 January 2013</ref>: “Adds 3 to the power of anything he pilots. Draws one battle destiny if unable to otherwise. During battle, Han may fire a [Virtual Block 8] blaster twice. Once per turn, if opponent is about to draw a weapon destiny targeting Han, they draw two and you choose one. Immune to attrition < 3 (<4 if armed).” (The capture of 21 July 2012 and the Virtual Master list (VMasterType, 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11) show a completely different text under this card, “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Force retrieval with Or Be Destroyed is immune to Secret Plans. While armed with a blaster, Han is defense value +2. While Or Be Destroyed on table, immune to attrition < Han's power.(Errata Text - September 9th, 2009)”; that looks like another card's text and waits for a ruling, so it is not a version here.) No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB8-01-Han_Solo_Innocent_Scoundrel-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
